title: Canonical Successor Process Hardening v1.1 Candidate
purpose: Refine the v1.0 successor-process candidate with immutable evidence-class attribution, non-blocking symmetric dependency semantics, rollback-candidate triggers, incremental Tier-A sweep inheritance, bounded permanent-unavailability accumulation, and scheduled process simplification.

delta_dependencies.reason: v1.1 refines rather than replaces the underlying v1.0 process-hardening candidate.

findings.name: Immutable evidence-class attribution
findings.summary: Producer assigns E0-E4 in immutable FindingRecord; integrator may cite but never reclassify; reclassification requires typed independent challenge with same-or-higher-class evidence.

findings.name: Directional versus symmetric delta relations
findings.summary: Only directional dependency relations may block/order admission; shared anchor/contract/invariant relations trigger stale review after upstream admission but never mutual blocking.

findings.name: Rollback candidate trigger
findings.summary: HIGH+ precisely attributed production incident raises rollback candidate and affected-scope freeze, but rollback execution remains explicit protected human decision.

findings.name: Bounded incremental Tier-A sweep
findings.summary: Publish exact section denominators and inherit qualified reviews across successors only when unit and reference-target hashes are unchanged; otherwise re-review affected closure.

findings.name: Permanent-unavailability backlog cap
findings.summary: Protected promotion closes while routine work continues; cap admitted-but-unpromoted semantic deltas at 50 and defer further admissions pending promotion capacity.

findings.name: Protocol simplification pressure
findings.summary: Scheduled negative-growth review proposes removal/merge/generalization/downgrade of low-yield or duplicate rules, with protected review for semantic governance changes.

findings.name: Milestones moved to process opening
findings.summary: Make DELTA_POOL, WORKING_FIVE_FILE_CANDIDATE, TIER_A_COMPLETE and FULL_ALL_TIER_COMPLETE first-class opening states rather than an end-note.

candidate_invariants: SPH2-INV-001 evidence class is immutable producer metadata absent typed independent challenge
SPH2-INV-002 symmetric shared-surface relations never create admission deadlock
SPH2-INV-003 rollback candidate raising and rollback execution are distinct authorities
SPH2-INV-004 sweep completion labels are denominator-bound and successor resweeps are affected-closure incremental
SPH2-INV-005 permanent human unavailability does not stop routine safe work and cannot create unbounded admitted semantic backlog
SPH2-INV-006 process complexity is subject to scheduled removal/merge review
SPH2-INV-007 successor milestone state is explicit before detailed status reporting
candidate_tests: TEST-SPH2-001 integrator attempt to mutate producer evidence_class is rejected
TEST-SPH2-002 EvidenceClassChallenge without same-or-higher-class supporting evidence cannot replace producer class
TEST-SPH2-003 two unresolved deltas sharing an anchor may both continue review without mutual blocking
TEST-SPH2-004 admission of one shared-anchor delta marks the other STALE_REVIEW before admission absent compatibility evidence
TEST-SPH2-005 HIGH SINGLE_COMMIT ProductionIncidentRecord raises ROLLBACK_CANDIDATE but does not execute rollback
TEST-SPH2-006 sweep-complete label without exact Tier-A denominator/source-root is invalid
TEST-SPH2-007 unchanged SectionUnit plus unchanged reference-target hashes inherits qualification across successor DesignEpoch
TEST-SPH2-008 changed reference-target hash marks otherwise unchanged SectionUnit STALE_REVIEW
TEST-SPH2-009 at 50 admitted-but-unpromoted semantic deltas next candidate becomes DEFERRED_PENDING_PROMOTION_CAPACITY
TEST-SPH2-010 simplification pass can propose rule removal but cannot silently weaken a protected boundary
required_review_before_admission: >=3 effective independent qualified high-quality reviewer families on the same bounded process target
immutable producer-assigned evidence classes plus challenge semantics
whole-source GSL-COMPARE/Reason/Proof/Evidence against v15.5 evolution, authority, HSA, AAP and DesignEpoch owners
deadlock/admission simulation for directional and symmetric dependency graphs
rollback authority and incident-attribution adversarial review
do_nothing: Without this refinement, the v1.0 candidate leaves evidence-class authority at risk of integrator bias, shared-surface dependencies can be misread as mutual blockers, rollback has no typed candidate trigger, Tier-A completion lacks a durable denominator/incremental inheritance rule, permanent unavailability can accumulate an unbounded backlog, and process complexity has only growth pressure.
promotion_boundary: Tracking-only refinement. Operational automation may follow safer fail-closed behavior now, but this delta does not amend canonical v15.5 or become v15.6 semantics until required review/admission completes.
